checks: unique values at each assessment day
univariate AUROC for every classifier feature
prevalence by hospital, consent version, sex and ethnicity
categorical levels exclusive to one recipient outcome class

grouped_split.rule: all six assessments remain in one split

warning_rules: dominant exact continuous value by day
hospital or consent identifier associated with one outcome
categorical level exclusive to one class
tuning_policy: Do not tune generation to one exact AUROC; seek plausible overlap and non-trivial prediction.
